description: Carry the lantern across drifting stairwalks to the beacon. Shift the lofts with their winches, walk along the stairs, and steer through each moving connection. Green planks enter a loft; gold planks leave it. Heights must meet. Wind and rope forces continue during crossing and dragging. A fall or END / CERTIFY before delivery ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass. Inspection, winch edits, blocked movement and unplanked Cross feedback remain available.
name: Lantern Loft V2 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
